The map shows '@' at (2,7) and 'P' at (3,7), with all '.' around. The notice board isn't rendered as 'o' because '@' is on it. So I'm on the board tile.

Let me try a fundamentally different approach: what if the movement DOES work but only when the destination is not blocked AND the engine allows leaving a blocked tile — but my issue is the player at (3,7) blocks right, and the board blocks... no, up/down/left are all '.'.

Let me try pressing E to interact with the notice board by facing it. Since it's on my tile, maybe I need to face a specific way. But E reports "nothing at [facing tile]". 

New idea: maybe the notice board is actually at (2,7) but it's a "read" object and I should press E while NOT facing any adjacent tile — i.e., the game reads the tile I'm standing on when I press E with no movement. But it always reports the facing tile.

Let me try: face down, then press E — it said "nothing at 2,8". Face up — "nothing at 2,6". So E only checks facing tile.

Let me try walking to a far tile like (11,8) near the workbench to see if the pathfinder gives a different error.
